content.text: I'm going through the screens one by one, as Yarden scrolling on his phone. I'm at screen 13 of 15 now and will finish the last two, then answer.

I'd go with **Harel, the "מניות" track (fund number 8522)**. I'm fairly sure, not totally. What decided it: Harel is a name I know, it's the first and biggest company on the list ("19.1 מיליארד ₪"), and in its section that track had the biggest number, "24.04%" next to "3 שנים". The fee was "0.55%", about the same as everything else.

I came for the S&P thing my friends talk about. Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" is right there with a fee of "0.56%", but it only shows "13.7%". The plain stocks one shows almost double for the same fee, so I'd take that one. If I'm wrong about what the 24% means, the S&P one at Harel is my backup.

**How it went:**
- **Where I looked:** I started with the heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" was already picked, which was good. Then the first company, Harel. I went down its list reading the track name on the right, the fee, and the big % numbers.
- **The other companies:** I kept scrolling past מור, אנליסט, מיטב, ילין לפידות, מגדל, מנורה מבטחים and אינפיניטי. It was the same few track names again and again with fees all around 0.55% to 0.7%.
- **Tempting numbers I passed:** I saw a few even bigger numbers, like "26.39%" and "25.86%". I wasn't sure which company they belonged to, because the company name only shows once at the top of its section.
- **When I'd have closed it:** by about screen 7 I was bored. On my phone I'd have closed it there and gone back to Harel.

**What I skipped:**
- The "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link
- The search box and the "123 מקור / מחושב" line
- The ? icons
- The note at the bottom about past returns
- The footer

**Words I didn't get:**
- "מט"ח": the S&P ones say 99% of that. Is that dollars?
- "דמי ניהול מההפקדה" vs "מההיסכון"
- "עוד לא דווח" with the orange "!" (it looked like a warning, so I stayed away)
- "פחות מ־3 שנים"
- "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול": I'm not sure if 24.04% is per year or the total for 3 years

**What bothered me:**
- More than 140 tracks that look the same, with no "start here" anywhere.
- I had no idea how much 0.55% is in actual shekels on my 30,000.
- Nothing told me what to actually do first to open one.
